I've also had the same problem, but quiet different..
I had around 1k+ objects which were created with CreateObject (in FS)
and my gamemode used CreateDynamicObject (28k) and CreateObject(200-300)
When I loaded the filterscript WHEN the server starts, the objects were not showing up.
But, when I unloaded the filterscript and reloaded the maps, I had no problems. Just convert all of your CreateObject into CreateDynamicObject

• Update streamer to the latest version.
